## Setup

```{python}
import altair as alt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display

from bdpinf import find_project_root
from bdpinf.analysis import FitModelConfig, fit_single_model
from bdpinf.simulation import simulate_birth_death_process
from bdpinf.visualization import save_chart
from bdpinf.visualization.altair_theme import PTOLQUAL
from bdpinf.visualization.genealogy import plot_genealogy_tree

figures_dir = find_project_root() / "figures" / "validation" / "single_epoch"
```

## Simulate One Dataset

```{python}
birth_rate = 5.0
death_rate = 4.0
time_span = 1.0
seed = 42

simulation_df = simulate_birth_death_process(
    birth_rates=birth_rate,
    death_rates=death_rate,
    times=time_span,
    random_seed=seed,
    ensure_non_extinct=True,
)
surviving_records = simulation_df.surviving_records
assert surviving_records is not None
ages = surviving_records["age"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)

print(f"Total records: {len(simulation_df)}")
print(f"Surviving records: {len(ages)}")
print(f"First 10 ages: {ages[:10].tolist()}")
assert simulation_df.records is not None
print(simulation_df.records.to_string())

newick_str = simulation_df.to_newick()
print("Newick:", newick_str)
```

## Genealogy Tree Plot

```{python}
genealogy_order = simulation_df.genealogy_dfs_order()
print(
    genealogy_order[
        ["dfs_index", "individual_id", "parent_id", "survived", "is_spine"]
    ].to_string(index=False)
)

genealogy_fig = plot_genealogy_tree(simulation_df)
save_chart(genealogy_fig, "vse02_genealogy_tree", output_dir=figures_dir)
genealogy_fig
```

## Fit One Simulation

```{python}
fit_config = FitModelConfig(
    times=time_span,
    is_ordered=True,
    initial_birth_rates=np.array([birth_rate], dtype=float),
    initial_death_rates=np.array([death_rate], dtype=float),
)
single_fit_result = fit_single_model(ages, fit_config, compute_covariance=True)
assert single_fit_result is not None
print(single_fit_result.params)
print(
    f"log-likelihood {single_fit_result.log_likelihood:.4f}, "
    f"converged={single_fit_result.converged}, "
    f"iterations={single_fit_result.n_iter}, "
    f"interior optimum={single_fit_result.at_interior_optimum}"
)
```

## Profile One Fit

```{python}
# Profile the fit using cProfile/pstats (replaces the %%prun cell magic)
import cProfile
import io
import pstats

profiler = cProfile.Profile()
profiler.enable()
_ = fit_single_model(ages, fit_config)
profiler.disable()

# Dump binary stats (compatible with graphical viewers)
profiler.dump_stats("prof-single-fit.prof")

# Write a short text report sorted by cumulative time (top 30 lines)
buf = io.StringIO()
ps = pstats.Stats(profiler, stream=buf).sort_stats("cumulative")
ps.print_stats(30)
report = buf.getvalue()
open("prof-single-fit.txt", "w").write(report)
print(report)
```

## NLL Convergence

```{python}
nll_history = list(single_fit_result.nll_history)

if nll_history:
    _nll_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Step": list(range(1, len(nll_history) + 1)),
            "NLL": nll_history,
        }
    )
    fig_nll = (
        alt.Chart(_nll_df)
        .mark_line(
            point=alt.OverlayMarkDef(size=30, color=PTOLQUAL[1]),
            color=PTOLQUAL[1],
            strokeWidth=2,
        )
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("Step:Q", title="Step", axis=alt.Axis(format="d")),
            y=alt.Y(
                "NLL:Q", title="Negative Log-Likelihood", scale=alt.Scale(zero=False)
            ),
        )
        .properties(
            title="Negative Log-Likelihood vs Optimization Step", width=700, height=350
        )
    )
    display(fig_nll)
    save_chart(fig_nll, "vse02_nll_convergence", output_dir=figures_dir)
else:
    print("No NLL history available for this fit.")
```

```{python}
# | label: compile-time-report
# | cache: false
# | echo: false

import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

doc_name = "methods_validation_single_fit_debug.qmd"
project_dir = Path(os.environ.get("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", Path.cwd()))
compile_log = project_dir / "_output" / "compile_times.json"
compile_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

duration_seconds = time.perf_counter() - __compile_start
timestamp = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

try:
    data = json.loads(compile_log.read_text()) if compile_log.exists() else {}
except Exception:
    data = {}

data[doc_name] = {"duration_seconds": duration_seconds, "timestamp": timestamp}
compile_log.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

print(f"Render duration (non-cached): {duration_seconds:.2f}s")
```
